description: This file contains the implementation of the AsyncTask class for Android, providing a framework for performing background operations and publishing results on the UI thread. It includes custom executors, threading behavior, and lifecycle methods.

classes.name: AsyncTask
classes.description: A generic class to perform background tasks and publish results on the UI thread, with configurable executors and lifecycle methods.

classes.name: AsyncTask.Status
classes.description: Enumeration representing the current state of an AsyncTask: PENDING, RUNNING, or FINISHED.

classes.name: InternalHandler
classes.description: Static inner class handling posting results and progress updates back to the UI thread.

classes.name: SerialExecutor
classes.description: A custom executor that runs tasks serially in order.

classes.name: WorkerRunnable
classes.description: A callable wrapper for executing background work with parameters.

classes.name: AsyncTaskResult
classes.description: A container class holding the task and associated data (result or progress).

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the AsyncTask instance.

methods.name: doInBackground
methods.description: Abstract method to perform background computations, must be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: onPreExecute
methods.description: Runs on the UI thread before doInBackground; used for setup.

methods.name: onPostExecute
methods.description: Runs on the UI thread after doInBackground completes; receives the result.

methods.name: onProgressUpdate
methods.description: Runs on the UI thread to update progress indicators.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Attempts to cancel executing the task.

methods.name: isCancelled
methods.description: Checks if the task was cancelled.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Starts the AsyncTask with parameters, using the default executor.

methods.name: executeOnExecutor
methods.description: Starts the AsyncTask with parameters on a specified executor.

methods.name: publishProgress
methods.description: Publishes progress updates to the UI thread.
